name: AXM Workshop Census Observatory
actions: scan a selected Workshop source tree
refuse comparisons between unnamed or different scopes
export a census receipt when explicitly requested
summary: A deterministic, scope-labeled Workshop inventory that keeps Hub tools, manifests, contracts, shared bodies, worlds, games, and asset zones honest instead of presenting one ambiguous module total.
notes: Integrated TEST module without new permissions or CANON authority. Scanning is read-only; files are written only for an explicit export path.
